proposal.model_rationale: I read the native 1750x1700 image, the page context and enlarged crops of bands 2, 5, 14, 16 and 17. The image is an Arabic letter from the Asset Transfer Committee (No. ٤١٧/٢٠٢٦, dated ١٥ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦م) with an English header line. It carries Table 42-1: 5 rows and 4 columns (م, فئة الأصول, الحد الأدنى للعمر المتبقي (سنة), أقصى درجة للحالة). There is a qualifier sentence above the table, three numbered notes below it, the signatory title with a signature stroke, an empty seal oval, and the FICTIONAL DOCUMENT footer. Bands 7-12 fall inside the ruled grid and are covered by the table rows. Every other band is read as a title, qualifier or note block, and the validator confirms that none is left unread. The page context heading reads 'APPENDIX A — TABLE 42-1 (ARABIC)', which matches the logical ٤٢-١. Its visual order ١-٤٢ was checked against the band 5 crop and passes RD6. The right half of band 17 holds only an empty oval with no text, so I recorded it as a line with an empty source and a note, and invented nothing. Points for the reviewer: the row 5 cell '٢٤ شهراً' (months) sits under a column headed in years; the diacritics on مبيِّن, تُقيِّم, المكوَّن and كلَّ need confirming; and how to interpret 'maximum grade' and Note 3 is a decision for a person, not a reading question. The reading is a proposal pending human review. prepared_by is left for the controller.
